# Known solutions

Read the lines here before investigating a problem: the symptom may already be known. `open` means understood but not fixed yet. Rules: [[kb-rules]].

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-indexes.py from each note's description: edit the notes, not this file. -->

## Notes

- [[brave-extension-worker-cached]] — OPEN (fix in owneet-base 0.0.39, to verify on a real update): a used web app profile gets a changed extension worker only when the manifest's version AND the worker's file name both change; one alone keeps the old worker or leaves none.
- [[brave-native-messaging-host-not-found]] — Brave never starts owneet-bridge: the native-messaging manifest in the web app's profile is ignored. Also the step-by-step path to see Brave's hidden errors.
- [[brave-reopens-old-tabs-in-a-web-app]] — Brave's window \"Fix the tabs slowing your browser\" lists other tabs of the web app, Spotify asks \"Listen on this phone\" or plays \"on Web Player\": Brave reopened the previous session's tabs, hidden behind the kiosk window.
- [[brave-widevine-window-over-a-web-app]] — Brave shows its own window 'Restart browser to enable Google Widevine' (Block / Allow) over a web app; the controller cannot close it. Comes after every Widevine download.
- [[controller-without-standard-layout-in-brave]] — In a web app LT / RT and the D-pad do nothing (the left stick, A and B work), and the right stick scrolls oddly: Brave reports the controller with no layout (mapping \"\"), in the Linux driver's order.
- [[empty-files-after-an-update-and-a-hard-stop]] — A package installed with pacman, then the machine stopped by hand: the package's files are 0 bytes (\"Exec format error\", the interface does not start). How to see it and repair it.
- [[gamescope-overlay-window-not-drawn-or-left-on-screen]] — A window meant as a gamescope external overlay is treated as an ordinary window (not drawn over the app), or its picture stays on screen after it is hidden. Seen on real hardware only, not in the VM.
- [[vm-run-hangs-after-exit]] — `vm/test.sh run` waits until its time is up and the VM never runs the command (the server sees no request): an `exit` in an earlier part of the command closed the VM's debug shell.
- [[vm-screen-stays-small]] — The test VM's screenshots stay 640×480 (or the old size) after enlarging QEMU's window; web pages look cramped: the console's screen takes its size only when cage starts.
